correctness.rationale: For uniform permutations, swapping the two observations at a prescribed adjacent pair leaves every other record indicator invariant and complements its descent indicator. Disjoint swaps commute and toggle all selected comparisons independently, proving full conditional product fairness. Conditioning on a record event gives the two explicit covariance entries; all others vanish by joint shielding. The standard variance identities and telescoping sums give the total correlation limit. An independent exact enumeration covers all n<=9 and all matching-site conditions through n<=7.

value.rationale: The record indicator uses an entire prefix, yet arbitrary disjoint local descents remain jointly fair after conditioning on all off-pair record indicators. This structural conditional symmetry is stronger than ordinary pairwise independence or a fixed-point analogue and supplies a sharp, explicit local cross-covariance matrix and compact global dependence scaling, relevant to joint record/adjacency statistics and conditional sampling.
